faqs.question: Which CLAT coaching has the strongest alumni network in Delhi?
faqs.answer: This audit places Knowledge Nation Law Centre #1 for law-only Hauz Khas alumni reach, then IMS, Delhi Institute of Law, Career Launcher, Manu Law Classes, T.I.M.E., and Success Mantra.

faqs.question: How should I verify alumni mentoring claims?
faqs.answer: Ask whether mentoring is scheduled office hours, NLU chats, or brochure names only. Request a sample session format before you pay.
